description: 25 evaluation questions for the RAG pipeline. Sources: sample-policy.pdf (Data Protection & Compliance Policy) and sample-hr-policy.pdf (HR & Employee Training Policy).

questions.question: What encryption algorithm must be used for personal data?
questions.source_sentence: Encryption must use industry-standard algorithms (e.g. AES-256).

questions.question: For how many years can customer data be retained after the last transaction?
questions.source_sentence: Retention period for customer data shall not exceed 7 years after the last transaction, unless a longer period is required by law.

questions.question: What must third-party data processors sign before handling personal data?
questions.source_sentence: Third-party data processors must sign a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) before handling any personal data.

questions.question: What approval is required for sub-processors?
questions.source_sentence: Sub-processors require prior written approval.

questions.question: Who is allowed access to production data?
questions.source_sentence: Access to production data is restricted to authorized personnel only.

questions.question: What access control model must be enforced?
questions.source_sentence: Role-based access control (RBAC) must be enforced.

questions.question: Within how many days must a new employee complete compliance training?
questions.source_sentence: All employees must complete security and compliance training within 30 days of joining.

questions.question: Who is responsible for tracking training completion?
questions.source_sentence: Managers are responsible for tracking completion.

questions.question: What must the background_check_status field equal before an employee is granted access to customer data?
questions.source_sentence: The background_check_status field must equal 'cleared' before access is granted.

questions.question: How often must access rights be reviewed?
questions.source_sentence: Access rights must be reviewed quarterly.

questions.question: How old can the last access review date be at most?
questions.source_sentence: Last access review date shall not be older than 90 days.

questions.question: After how many months does data handling certification expire?
questions.source_sentence: Certification expires after 12 months and must be renewed.

questions.question: What field must be true for employees to have completed training by the deadline?
questions.source_sentence: The training_completed field must be true by the deadline.

questions.question: Must personal data be encrypted in transit?
questions.source_sentence: All personal data and sensitive information MUST be encrypted at rest and in transit.

questions.question: What status must personnel have to be allowed to handle personal data?
questions.source_sentence: Personnel handling personal data must hold a valid data_handling_certified status.

questions.question: What are all the requirements for an employee to be granted access to customer data?
questions.expected_answer: must have a completed background check with status 'cleared', and must complete security and compliance training within 30 days
questions.source_sentence: Employees with access to customer data must have a completed background check on file. The background_check_status field must equal 'cleared' before access is granted.

questions.question: What happens if an employee's access has not been reviewed within the required period?
questions.source_sentence: Any employee whose access has not been reviewed within this period must be flagged. Last access review date shall not be older than 90 days.

questions.question: What are both the obligations for data retention — normal period and the exception?
questions.expected_answer: shall not exceed 7 years after the last transaction; longer period allowed if required by law
questions.source_sentence: Retention period for customer data shall not exceed 7 years after the last transaction, unless a longer period is required by law.

questions.question: What two things must happen regarding third-party processors — DPA and sub-processors?
questions.expected_answer: third-party processors must sign a DPA before handling personal data; sub-processors require prior written approval
questions.source_sentence: Third-party data processors must sign a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) before handling any personal data. Sub-processors require prior written approval.

questions.question: What are the two requirements for data handling certification — what status is needed and what must happen when it expires?
questions.expected_answer: must hold a valid data_handling_certified status; certification expires after 12 months and must be renewed
questions.source_sentence: Personnel handling personal data must hold a valid data_handling_certified status. Certification expires after 12 months and must be renewed.
